topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by connecting it to earlier histopathology practicals and outlining the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor Viruses and the Discovery of Cellular Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for testing cell transformation.

topics.label: Concepts and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and describe their distinct genetic mechanisms and regulatory effects in cell cycle control.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Progression of Genetic Instability in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the molecular failures in DNA repair, replication, and mitosis that generate genetic instability and explain how this instability accelerates multi-step tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the genetics of inherited cancer predisposition syndromes and their implications for tumor evolution and malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing with an offer to answer questions, suggested reading, and a preview of the next lecture.
